group.name: fancyavatar
group.title: Fancy Avatar Settings
group.description: Configure avatar provider and settings for your forum. Automatically assigns unique avatars to users without custom avatars.

enabled.title: Enable Fancy Avatar
enabled.description: Enable or disable the Fancy Avatar plugin. When enabled, users without custom avatars will automatically receive avatars.

provider.title: Avatar Provider
provider.description: Select which avatar service to use. DiceBear offers 24+ artistic styles. UI Avatars generates clean initial-based avatars. Avataaars creates customizable cartoon characters.
provider.optionscode:
select
dicebear=DiceBear (24+ Artistic Styles)
uiavatars=UI Avatars (Initials-Based)
avataaars=Avataaars (Customizable Characters)

size.title: Avatar Size (pixels)
size.description: The width and height of the generated avatar in pixels. Recommended: 64, 128, 256.

seed.title: Avatar Seed Method
seed.description: How avatar uniqueness is determined. Username gives each user a unique look; Email provides consistency across services; UID uses the numeric user ID; Random generates a different avatar each page load.
seed.optionscode:
select
username=Username (Unique per user)
email=Email (Consistent across services)
uid=User ID (Numeric seed)
random=Random (Different each load)

radius.title: Border Radius (%)
radius.description: Roundedness of avatar corners. 0 = square corners, 50 = fully round (circle). Applied as CSS border-radius. Default: 50

exclude_groups.title: Exclude User Groups
exclude_groups.description: Comma-separated list of usergroup IDs to exclude from automatic avatar assignment. Useful for admin accounts or special groups.

refresh_on_view.title: Refresh Avatar on Profile View
refresh_on_view.description: When enabled, avatar URLs are refreshed to reflect current settings when a profile is viewed. Disable for better performance on high-traffic forums.

style.title: DiceBear Style
style.description: Visual style for DiceBear avatars. Only applies when provider is set to DiceBear. Visit DiceBear Styles for previews.
style.optionscode:
select
adventurer=Adventurer
adventurer-neutral=Adventurer Neutral
avataaars=Avataaars
avataaars-neutral=Avataaars Neutral
big-ears=Big Ears
big-ears-neutral=Big Ears Neutral
big-smile=Big Smile
bottts=Bottts
bottts-neutral=Bottts Neutral
fun-emoji=Fun Emoji
icons=Icons
identicon=Identicon
initials=Initials
lorelei=Lorelei
lorelei-neutral=Lorelei Neutral
micah=Micah
micah-neutral=Micah Neutral
miniavs=Miniavs
personas=Personas
pixel-art=Pixel Art
pixel-art-neutral=Pixel Art Neutral
rings=Rings
shapes=Shapes
thumbs=Thumbs

bgcolor.title: DiceBear Background Color
bgcolor.description: Background color for DiceBear avatars. 'Transparent' uses the style's default. Only applies to DiceBear provider.
bgcolor.optionscode:
select
transparent=Transparent (Default)
b6e3f4=Light Blue
c0aede=Lavender
d1d4f9=Light Purple
ffd5dc=Pink
ffdfbf=Peach
ffffff=White
000000=Black

shape.title: DiceBear Avatar Shape
shape.description: Shape for supported DiceBear styles. Default uses the style's native shape.

mouth.title: DiceBear Mouth Style
mouth.description: Mouth expression for DiceBear avataaars style. Default uses random selection.
mouth.optionscode:
select
default=Default
smile=Smile
laughing=Laughing
nervous=Nervous
sad=Sad
open=Open
serious=Serious
tongue=Tongue

expression.title: DiceBear Expression Style
expression.description: Facial expression for supported DiceBear styles. Default uses random selection.
expression.optionscode:
select
default=Default
happy=Happy
sad=Sad
angry=Angry
surprised=Surprised
shocked=Shocked
blink=Blink
wink=Wink
laughing=Laughing

uiavatars_color.title: UI Avatars Font Color
uiavatars_color.description: Font color for UI Avatars initials. Only applies when provider is set to UI Avatars. 'Default' uses automatic contrast.
uiavatars_color.optionscode:
select
default=Default (Auto Contrast)
ffffff=White
000000=Black
ff0000=Red
0000ff=Blue
008000=Green
800080=Purple
ff6600=Orange

uiavatars_bold.title: UI Avatars Bold Text
uiavatars_bold.description: Display initials in bold font for UI Avatars. Only applies when provider is set to UI Avatars.

uiavatars_length.title: UI Avatars Initials Length
uiavatars_length.description: Number of characters to use from the username for initials. Only applies when provider is set to UI Avatars.

avataaars_style.title: Avataaars Avatar Style
avataaars_style.description: Choose between Circle (with background) or Transparent (no background) for Avataaars. Only applies when provider is set to Avataaars.
